title: Preserve template relationships and generation state
description: Carry templates, assignments, independent content, sparse selections, and resolved generation state through autosave, snapshots, undo/redo, export registration, and immutable print preparations without silent flattening.
acceptanceCriteria: Autosave and reload preserve template identities, input definitions, assignments, values, overrides, and independent-content variants
Named snapshots and undo/redo restore relationships rather than only resolved trees
Export registration includes every referenced template, independent content record, and local asset identity
A print preparation records exact source identities, normalized values, overrides, PaginationPlan, resolved scene identity, and diagnostics needed to reproduce generation
No persistence path silently replaces a template assignment with flattened content
Template creation, assignment, data entry, sparse selection, pagination preview, and generation are keyboard operable and verified using Playwright

steps.details: Add relationship-preserving template, assignment, selection, and independent-content fields to existing autosave, reload, snapshot, and history serialization seams.
Expose stable references for every template, content record, and asset required by the project without implementing the later PRD-24 bundle format.
Extend immutable preparation inputs with source identities/versions, normalized assignment values, overrides, exact PaginationPlan, scene identity, and generation diagnostics.
Create a mixed sparse multi-page project, snapshot, edit/undo/redo, reload, generate, and assert relationships remain unflattened and preparation page order matches preview.

technicalNotes: Keep this ten-minute increment to wiring existing generic persistence/history/preparation serializers; complete workspace export/import remains PRD 24.
A preparation records software generation assumptions only and must not imply that printing occurred.
